snippet.title: The Man Who Gave Water to a Thirsty Dog 🐶💧 True Story for Kids | Islam for Kids #shorts
snippet.description:
Do you know the story of the very thirsty dog?

Our beloved Prophet Muhammad (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam) told us about a man who was very thirsty on a hot day. He climbed down a well and drank. When he came up, he saw a dog so thirsty it was licking the wet ground. So he climbed down again, filled his shoe with water and gave the dog a drink. Allah thanked him and forgave him. The Companions asked if there is a reward for being kind to animals, and he said there is a reward for kindness to every living creature.

Who will your little one be kind to today? A cat, a bird, or a dog?
